verdict.rationale: Martin documents built-in recurring background tasks: daily or weekly email briefings and a wake-up call at a set time every morning. These are fixed task types, not general user-defined recurring workflows. Reminders are one-off pings at a specified time, and shortcuts trigger multi-step actions on demand, so neither is evidenced as a recurring schedule. missing for 10: scheduling arbitrary or custom workflows (e.g., shortcuts) on a recurrence, documented recurrence controls (cron/intervals), recurring reminders, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Martin can send you daily or weekly briefings via email.
Martin can call you at a specific time every morning to wake you up with the weather and your schedule.
